verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so asking whether it supports real-time WebSocket handling in edge or serverless functions is a fair question. The evidence covers web services, background workers, workflows, a CDN for static assets, and autoscaling, but never mentions edge or serverless functions or WebSocket connections. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
